title: One Task, Many Interfaces: Simple Cross-Interface Consistency Training Improves LLM Agent Robustness
title_zh: 单一任务，多种接口：简单的跨接口一致性训练可提升 LLM 智能体的鲁棒性

paragraphs.en: Post-training binds the competence of an LLM agent to the interface it was trained on. Semantics-preserving perturbations of that interface, such as renaming an action or changing the notation, leave the underlying task unchanged yet make the agent worse at it. Scoring each sample independently means interface randomization only broadens this dependence from a single interface to the training interface distribution, so out-of-distribution perturbations still degrade the agent. We propose Cross-Interface Policy Regularization (CIPR), a self-supervised objective that replaces action names with uninformative identifiers and presents each training sample under two interfaces in which equivalent actions are identified by construction. CIPR penalizes the KL divergence between the action distributions induced under the two interfaces, so the policy behaves consistently across them. We evaluate CIPR in both supervised and reinforcement-learning post-training, where it improves robustness. On agentic function calling, held-out interface perturbations reduce the accuracy of a post-trained agent by nearly 25%, and CIPR recovers 10.5% while leaving accuracy on the unchanged interface intact. 1 1 1 Code repository: https://github.com/ArtinTD/cross-interface-policy-regularization .
paragraphs.zh: 训练后，大型语言模型智能体的能力会与其所受训练的接口绑定在一起。 对这一接口进行语义保留的扰动（例如重命名某个动作或更改表示法），虽然不会改变底层任务本身，却会导致智能体在该任务上的表现变差。 独立地对每个样本进行评分意味着，接口的随机化只会将这种依赖关系从单个接口扩展到训练接口分布，因此分布外的扰动仍然会损害智能体的表现。 我们提出了跨接口策略正则化（CIPR），这是一种自监督目标：它将动作名称替换为无信息量的标识符，并在每个训练样本中呈现两种接口，其中等效的动作通过构造被明确识别。 CIPR 惩罚在两种接口下所诱导的动作分布之间的 KL 散度，从而确保策略在这两种接口下一致地运行。 我们在监督学习和强化学习后的训练阶段均对 CIPR 进行了评估，结果表明它能提升模型的鲁棒性。 在智能体函数调用任务中，未参与训练的接口扰动会使后训练智能体的准确率下降近 25%，而 CIPR 能够恢复其中的 10.5%，同时保持其在未受扰动的接口上的准确率不变。 1 1 1 代码仓库：https://github.com/ArtinTD/cross-interface-policy-regularization .

paragraphs.en: Language models are now trained to act as tool-using agents, either natively ( Qwen Team, 2026 ; Kimi Team, 2025 ) , or by fine-tuning on agent trajectories and reinforcement learning from task rewards ( Zeng et al., 2024 ; Qian et al., 2026 ) . What these agents learn, however, is tied to the interface through which their tools are presented, meaning the names, descriptions, and argument schemas of the available tools. Figure 1 illustrates this with a weather agent trained on a single interface, which fails when its forecast tool is renamed and when a cheaper equivalent is added, although neither change alters the task. Agents fine-tuned on trajectories can lose most of their task success when action names are minimally rewritten ( Gu et al., 2026 ) , and function-calling models degrade when tools are renamed, similar tools are added, or requests are rephrased ( Ye et al., 2024 ; Rabinovich and Tavor, 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2026b ) . Such changes are routine in deployment, where registries combine tools from different servers, providers revise their schemas, and users misspell requests ( Zhou et al., 2026b ) . Interfaces can also be manipulated, since edits to a tool’s description alone can make agents prefer it over equivalent tools ( Faghih et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 如今，语言模型被训练为能够使用工具的智能体，这可以通过原生能力实现（Qwen Team, 2026；Kimi Team, 2025），也可以通过在智能体轨迹上进行微调以及基于任务奖励进行强化学习来实现（Zeng et al., 2024；Qian et al., 2026）。 然而，这些智能体所学到的内容与其工具呈现的接口密切相关，也就是说，它们依赖于可用工具的名称、描述和参数模式。 图1通过一个在单一接口上训练的天气智能体说明了这一点：当它的天气预报工具被重命名时，以及当一个价格更低的等效工具被添加时，该智能体都会失效，尽管这两种变化都没有改变任务本身。 在轨迹上进行微调的智能体可能会在行动名称被轻微修改时就失去大部分任务成功能力（Gu et al., 2026）；而函数调用模型在工具被重命名、添加了类似工具或请求被重新表述时性能也会下降（Ye et al., 2024；Rabinovich and Tavor, 2025；Zhou et al., 2026b）。 这类变化在实际部署中十分常见：注册表会整合来自不同服务器的工具，提供商会修改其参数模式，用户也可能会拼写错误请求（Zhou et al., 2026b）。 接口本身也可以被操控，因为仅通过编辑一个工具的描述，就足以让智能体更倾向于使用它，而不是其他等效的工具（Faghih et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: This failure is an instance of shortcut learning ( Geirhos et al., 2020 ) . On a fixed training interface, a policy that reads the tool descriptions and a policy that relies on a familiar name or a position in the tool list make the same calls and earn the same reward, so the task objective has no reason to prefer the first. The second policy fails as soon as the interface changes, even if the task is unchanged. Such a policy can still succeed on new tasks under its training interface, so the failure is one of generalizing across interfaces rather than of fitting noise in the training examples.
paragraphs.zh: 这种失败是捷径学习的一个实例（Geirhos 等人，2020）。 在固定的训练界面中，一个读取工具说明的策略与一个依赖熟悉名称或工具列表中位置的策略会发出相同的调用并获得相同的奖励，因此任务目标没有理由优先选择前者。 一旦界面发生变化，第二种策略就会失败，即使任务本身没有改变。 这类策略在其训练界面下处理新任务时仍可能成功，因此这种失败源于跨界面的泛化问题，而非对训练样本中噪声的拟合。

paragraphs.en: Prior training methods reduce this sensitivity by changing what the agent trains on. Function masking replaces tool and argument names with random strings ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , which removes one cue but leaves others, such as a tool’s position or the set of tools offered. Multi-interface training, also known as domain randomization, varies tool schemas, metadata, and question formats during training ( Zhou et al., 2026b ; Liu et al., 2026a ) , and synthetic corpora such as ToolACE broaden the tools seen in training ( Liu et al., 2025 ) . Both approaches still score each training interface on its own. Their objective asks the policy to succeed under every interface it sees, but never to treat equivalent interfaces alike, so a policy can fit every training variant while keeping a shortcut that fails on a new kind of change, as in the middle column of Figure 1 .
paragraphs.zh: 早期的训练方法通过改变智能体训练的数据来降低这种敏感性。 函数掩码将工具和参数名称替换为随机字符串（Lin et al., 2025），这虽然移除了一个线索，但保留了其他线索，例如工具的位置或所提供的工具集合。 多接口训练，也称为领域随机化，在训练过程中会变化工具模式、元数据和问题格式（Zhou et al., 2026b; Liu et al., 2026a），而像 ToolACE 这样的合成语料库则扩展了训练中接触到的工具范围（Liu et al., 2025）。 这两种方法仍然对每个训练接口单独进行评分。 它们的目标是要求策略在遇到的每一个接口下都能成功，但从未要求将等效的接口一视同仁，因此一个策略可能适应所有训练变体，同时保留一条在新类型变化下会失效的捷径，正如图 1 中间列所示。

paragraphs.en: The interface changes an agent meets in deployment cannot all be anticipated, so robustness should not depend on training on each of them. Instead, the agent should treat interfaces that offer equivalent tools alike, including interfaces it has never seen. We propose Cross-Interface Policy Regularization (CIPR), which trains for this property directly (Figure 2 ). CIPR uses a correspondence that multi-interface training discards, since whenever we construct a perturbed interface, we know which of its tools is equivalent to which tool in the original. We canonicalize each training interface, replacing every tool name with a neutral identifier such as function_01 , so that names carry no task information. Canonicalization leaves other cues in place, such as a tool’s position, so we pair the canonical interface with a perturbed copy in which the tools are renamed, reordered, and joined by degraded twins. We then penalize the KL divergence between the agent’s action distributions under the two interfaces, with the canonical interface as the reference. Unlike prior consistency regularization, which asks a model for the same output under both inputs ( Xie et al., 2020 ; Zhou et al., 2026a ) , this term lets the response change with the tool names and compares only the distributions over actions, with each tool matched to its counterpart through the known correspondence. The consistency KL has two terms. The rescoring consistency KL holds a response fixed and compares the action distributions along it, which needs no additional generation, and the rollout consistency KL lets each interface produce its own responses, since a different interface can call for different reasoning. We add both terms to the task loss, and they need no labels beyond those of the task.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate CIPR in reinforcement-learning and supervised post-training under interface perturbations held out from training. On function calling with two backbones, CIPR is more robust than the base model and standard post-training, and it improves on multi-interface training in all three groups of held-out perturbations while keeping original accuracy (Table 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在训练时保留的接口扰动条件下，对 CIPR 在强化学习和监督式后训练中的表现进行了评估。 在使用两种骨干网络进行函数调用时，CIPR 比基础模型和标准后训练方法更具鲁棒性；在所有三组保留的扰动条件下，它都能优于多接口训练方法，同时保持原有的准确率（表 1）。

sents.en: We evaluate CIPR in reinforcement-learning and supervised post-training under interface perturbations held out from training.

paragraphs.en: CIPR, a self-supervised objective that penalizes the KL divergence between an agent’s action distributions under two interfaces whose equivalent actions are known by construction, with a rescoring consistency KL that needs no additional generation and a rollout consistency KL that lets the agent’s reasoning differ between the interfaces (Section 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: CIPR 是一种自监督目标，它惩罚智能体在两个接口下的动作分布之间的 KL 散度——这两个接口的等效动作是构造上已知的；其中，重评分一致性 KL 无需额外的生成过程，而展开一致性 KL 则允许智能体在不同接口间的推理存在差异（第 3 节）。

paragraphs.en: A tool-calling instantiation that canonicalizes tool names and pairs every training interface with a perturbed copy in which only descriptions and schemas identify the right tool (Sections 3.1 and 3.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 一种工具调用实例化方法，该方法对工具名称进行标准化，并将每个训练接口与其扰动副本配对，在扰动副本中仅通过描述和模式来识别正确的工具（第 3.1 节和第 3.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: Experiments in reinforcement-learning and supervised post-training, in which CIPR improves on standard post-training and multi-interface training under held-out interface perturbations and makes an agent fine-tuned on trajectories robust to renamed actions (Section 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 强化学习和监督式后训练实验表明，在保留的接口扰动条件下，CIPR 相较于标准后训练和多接口训练表现更优，并使在轨迹上微调的智能体对重命名后的动作具有鲁棒性（第 4 节）。

paragraphs.en: Tool-use benchmarks mostly evaluate agents on the interface released with them ( Patil et al., 2025 ; Barres et al., 2026 ) , yet which tool an agent calls depends on how the tools are presented. Renaming or corrupting tool and argument names, rephrasing queries, and adding related tools all lower accuracy ( Ye et al., 2024 ; Rabinovich and Tavor, 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2026b ) , the wording and order of equivalent tools change which one is selected ( Faghih et al., 2025 ; Blankenstein et al., 2026 ) , and agents call a tool whose parameters fit the query even when the tool does not serve it ( Liu et al., 2026b ) . Similar sensitivity to semantics-preserving rewrites appears in mathematical reasoning ( Mirzadeh et al., 2025 ) and in choices among reordered options ( Egressy and Stühmer, 2026 ) . Training can deepen this reliance: PIPE, which rewrites environment interfaces while preserving task semantics, finds that fine-tuning on trajectories increases reliance on the training interface ( Gu et al., 2026 ) , and agent-tuning data entangles format following with reasoning ( Chen et al., 2024 ) . These studies measure the problem, whereas we address it during training.
paragraphs.zh: 工具使用基准测试主要评估智能体在随附接口上的表现（Patil 等，2025；Barres 等，2026），但智能体调用哪个工具取决于工具的呈现方式。 重命名或破坏工具和参数名称、改写查询以及添加相关工具都会降低准确性（Ye 等，2024；Rabinovich 和 Tavor，2025；Zhou 等，2026b）；等价工具的措辞和顺序变化会影响所选工具（Faghih 等，2025；Blankenstein 等，2026）；即使某个工具无法解决查询，智能体仍可能调用其参数与查询匹配的工具（Liu 等，2026b）。 对语义保留性改写类似的敏感性也出现在数学推理中（Mirzadeh 等，2025），以及在重新排序的选项中进行选择时（Egressy 和 Stühmer，2026）。 训练可能会加深这种依赖：PIPE 在保持任务语义的同时重写了环境接口，研究发现，在轨迹上进行微调会增加对训练接口的依赖（Gu 等，2026）；而智能体调优数据则使格式遵循与推理相互交织（Chen 等，2024）。 这些研究只是测量了该问题，而我们则在训练过程中解决它。

paragraphs.en: Most remedies applied during training change what the agent sees. They hide a cue, as function masking replaces names with random strings ( Lin et al., 2025 ; Qian et al., 2026 ) ; broaden the tools and environments seen in training, through synthesized APIs and agent data ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; He et al., 2025 ; Mekala et al., 2024 ) , generated environments ( Sullivan et al., 2025 ; Du et al., 2026 ) , and tools that change over time ( Chen et al., 2025 ) ; or pair clean and perturbed versions of the same tasks ( Lv et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . Closest to our setting, ToolRL-DR randomizes the interface during tool-use reinforcement learning ( Zhou et al., 2026b ) , as multi-format supervision does for question formats ( Liu et al., 2026a ) . Others change the target instead, scoring an action by its effect rather than its exact string ( Tang et al., 2026 ) . Outside agents, shortcuts of this kind persist after the core features are learned ( Qiu et al., 2024 ) , and regularization or data rebalancing aimed at them can suppress causal features or lower worst-group accuracy ( Hong et al., 2025 ; LaBonte et al., 2024 ) . In all of these, the objective still scores each training example on its own. We keep the perturbed interfaces and add a term that compares the policy across them.
paragraphs.zh: 训练期间采用的大多数方法都会改变智能体所看到的内容。 这些方法会隐藏某种提示，例如通过函数掩码将名称替换为随机字符串（Lin et al., 2025；Qian et al., 2026）；通过合成的 API 和智能体数据（Liu et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2025；He et al., 2025；Mekala et al., 2024）、生成的环境（Sullivan et al., 2025；Du et al., 2026）以及随时间变化的工具（Chen et al., 2025），来扩展训练中所接触到的工具和环境；或者将同一任务的干净版本与扰动版本配对（Lv et al., 2026；Chen et al., 2026）。 最接近我们设定的是 ToolRL-DR，它在工具使用强化学习过程中对接口进行随机化（Zhou et al., 2026b），这与多格式监督对问题格式的处理方式类似（Liu et al., 2026a）。 其他方法则转而改变目标，即根据动作的效果而非其精确的字符串来表示来评分（Tang et al., 2026）。 在智能体领域之外，这类捷径在核心特征被学习之后仍然存在（Qiu et al., 2024），而针对这些捷径的正则化或数据再平衡可能会抑制因果特征或降低最差群体的准确率（Hong et al., 2025；LaBonte et al., 2024）。 在所有这些方法中，目标函数仍然对每个训练样本进行独立评分。 我们保留扰动后的接口，并添加一个用于比较不同接口下策略的项。

paragraphs.en: Consistency regularization penalizes the divergence between a model’s predictions on two versions of an input that should receive the same prediction, such as an example and its augmentation in semi-supervised learning ( Xie et al., 2020 ) or semantically equivalent pairs in domain generalization ( Gao et al., 2024 ) . It has been applied to reinforcement-learning policies on augmented observations ( Raileanu et al., 2021 ) and to vision-language-action policies under perturbed instructions and observations ( Luo et al., 2026 ) . In concurrent work, PIRL applies it to reinforcement learning of multimodal LLMs with a per-token KL between the policy’s next-token distributions for the same response under a clean and an adversarially perturbed prompt ( Zhou et al., 2026a ) . Each of these methods compares the two predictions directly, which assumes the correct output is the same under both inputs. Renaming tools breaks this assumption, because the correct call is then written with different tokens, so we compare distributions over actions matched through the known correspondence between the two interfaces.
paragraphs.zh: 一致性正则化惩罚模型对两个本应得到相同预测的输入版本（例如，在半监督学习中的样本及其增强版本（Xie et al., 2020），或在领域泛化中的语义等价对（Gao et al., 2024））所做出预测之间的差异。 该方法已被应用于基于增强观测的强化学习策略（Raileanu et al., 2021），以及面对扰动指令和观测的视觉-语言-动作策略（Luo et al., 2026）。 在并行研究中，PIRL 将其应用于多模态大型语言模型（LLM）的强化学习，通过计算在干净提示和对抗性扰动提示下，同一响应对策的下一个词元分布之间的每词元 KL 散度来实现（Zhou et al., 2026a）。 这些方法中的每一种都直接比较两个预测，这假设了两种输入下的正确输出是相同的。 重命名工具会破坏这一假设，因为此时正确的调用会使用不同的词元来编写，因此我们需要通过两个接口之间已知的对应关系来匹配并比较动作分布。

paragraphs.en: We consider an LLM agent that receives a user query together with an interface, which lists the available tools with their names, descriptions, and argument schemas. At each step the agent either calls one of the listed tools or responds without a call. A perturbation of the interface is semantics-preserving when the tool that solves the task is still available and still solves it, even though its name, its position, or the surrounding options have changed. We want the agent to assign the same probability to equivalent tools under such perturbations, and CIPR trains for this in three steps. We canonicalize the interface so that tool names carry no task information (Section 3.1 ), pair every training example with a perturbed copy of its interface (Section 3.2 ), and penalize the divergence between the agent’s action distributions under the two interfaces (Section 3.3 ). Figure 2 summarizes the procedure.
paragraphs.zh: 我们考虑一个 LLM 智能体，它会接收用户查询以及一个界面，该界面列出了可用工具的名称、描述和参数模式。 在每一步中，该智能体要么调用列出的工具之一，要么在不调用的情况下作出回应。 如果解决任务的工具仍然可用且仍能完成任务，即使其名称、位置或周围的选项发生了变化，那么对界面的扰动就是语义保持的。 我们希望智能体在这样的扰动下为等效的工具分配相同的概率，而 CIPR 通过三个步骤对此进行训练。 我们对界面进行规范化处理，使工具名称不包含任何任务信息（第 3.1 节），将每个训练示例与其界面的扰动副本配对（第 3.2 节），并对智能体在两种界面下动作分布之间的差异施加惩罚（第 3.3 节）。 图 2 总结了这一流程。

paragraphs.en: The most direct shortcut available to a trained agent is a familiar tool name. Because a name that led to correct calls during training usually still does so at test time, a policy can select tools by name without reading their descriptions, and function-calling models are known to be misled by naming conventions ( Lin et al., 2025 ) . We remove this shortcut by canonicalizing the interface, replacing every tool name with a neutral identifier and every argument name with an identifier numbered within its tool, so that forecast(city, date) becomes function_01(arg_01, arg_02) . We keep descriptions, types, required arguments, and argument values unchanged, so the agent has to read the descriptions to tell the tools apart, and we apply the same mapping to every reference to these names in the query, in earlier turns, and in the training targets. At inference, a canonicalization adapter applies this mapping to the incoming interface and translates the generated call back to the executable API, so the deployed tools themselves are never modified. Canonicalization is related to function masking ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , a training strategy that replaces names with random strings so that the model attends to descriptions; unlike masking, we also apply the mapping at inference, so the policy never meets the original names.
paragraphs.zh: 训练有素的智能体能够使用的最直接捷径，就是某个熟悉的工具名称。 因为在训练期间能引导模型正确调用的名称，在测试时通常仍然有效，因此策略无需阅读工具描述即可通过名称选择工具；而已有研究表明，函数调用模型容易受到命名惯例的误导（Lin et al., 2025）。 我们通过标准化接口来消除这一捷径：将每个工具名称替换为中性标识符，并将每个参数名称替换为该工具内部编号的标识符，例如 forecast(city, date) 会被转换为 function_01(arg_01, arg_02)。 我们保留描述、类型、必需参数和参数值的原样不变，因此智能体必须阅读描述才能区分不同工具；同时，我们对查询中、早期回合中以及训练目标中所有对这些名称的引用都应用相同的映射规则。 在推理阶段，标准化适配器会将此映射规则应用于传入的接口，并将生成的调用翻译回可执行的 API，因此部署的工具本身绝不会被修改。 标准化与函数掩码（Lin et al., 2025）相关，后者是一种训练策略，通过用随机字符串替换名称来促使模型关注描述；但与掩码不同，我们还在推理阶段应用这一映射，因此策略永远不会接触到原始名称。

sents.en: The most direct shortcut available to a trained agent is a familiar tool name.
sents.zh: 训练有素的智能体能够使用的最直接捷径，就是某个熟悉的工具名称。

sents.en: Because a name that led to correct calls during training usually still does so at test time, a policy can select tools by name without reading their descriptions, and function-calling models are known to be misled by naming conventions ( Lin et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 因为在训练期间能引导模型正确调用的名称，在测试时通常仍然有效，因此策略无需阅读工具描述即可通过名称选择工具；而已有研究表明，函数调用模型容易受到命名惯例的误导（Lin et al., 2025）。

sents.en: We remove this shortcut by canonicalizing the interface, replacing every tool name with a neutral identifier and every argument name with an identifier numbered within its tool, so that forecast(city, date) becomes function_01(arg_01, arg_02) .
sents.zh: 我们通过标准化接口来消除这一捷径：将每个工具名称替换为中性标识符，并将每个参数名称替换为该工具内部编号的标识符，例如 forecast(city, date) 会被转换为 function_01(arg_01, arg_02)。

sents.en: We keep descriptions, types, required arguments, and argument values unchanged, so the agent has to read the descriptions to tell the tools apart, and we apply the same mapping to every reference to these names in the query, in earlier turns, and in the training targets.
sents.zh: 我们保留描述、类型、必需参数和参数值的原样不变，因此智能体必须阅读描述才能区分不同工具；同时，我们对查询中、早期回合中以及训练目标中所有对这些名称的引用都应用相同的映射规则。

sents.en: At inference, a canonicalization adapter applies this mapping to the incoming interface and translates the generated call back to the executable API, so the deployed tools themselves are never modified.
sents.zh: 在推理阶段，标准化适配器会将此映射规则应用于传入的接口，并将生成的调用翻译回可执行的 API，因此部署的工具本身绝不会被修改。

sents.en: Canonicalization is related to function masking ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , a training strategy that replaces names with random strings so that the model attends to descriptions; unlike masking, we also apply the mapping at inference, so the policy never meets the original names.
sents.zh: 标准化与函数掩码（Lin et al., 2025）相关，后者是一种训练策略，通过用随机字符串替换名称来促使模型关注描述；但与掩码不同，我们还在推理阶段应用这一映射，因此策略永远不会接触到原始名称。

paragraphs.en: The consistency KL of Section 3.3 needs only a perturbed interface in which we know which tool is equivalent to which canonical tool. We design ours to also remove the cues that canonicalization leaves in place, such as a tool’s position in the tool list or the identifiers seen during training, and construct it for every training example from the canonical interface in three steps. We first give every tool a degraded twin ( twin expansion ), a copy whose description states that it is worse, for example deprecated or slower, or whose schema replaces an argument the task needs with an unrelated one. We then give the expanded tool list new identifiers ( relabeling ) and shuffle the tools and their arguments ( reordering ). The query and the descriptions of the original tools are unchanged, and each twin differs from its original only in its description or schema. Appendix B lists the exact operations.

paragraphs.en: The task objective never compares which tools the policy chooses under the canonical and the perturbed interface. We add this comparison by building on consistency regularization ( Xie et al., 2020 ; Raileanu et al., 2021 ) , which penalizes the divergence between a model’s predictions on two versions of an input that call for the same output. An agent’s correct response, however, changes with the interface, because the tools it calls have different names, and what stays fixed is the correspondence between equivalent tools, which is known from the construction of the perturbed interface. We therefore compare the policy’s distributions over actions rather than over tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 任务目标从未比较过策略在标准接口和扰动接口下所选择的工具。 我们通过基于一致性正则化（Xie et al., 2020；Raileanu et al., 2021）来添加这一比较，该方法会惩罚模型对两个需要相同输出的输入版本所做的预测之间的差异。 然而，智能体的正确响应会随着接口的不同而改变，因为它调用的工具名称不同，而保持不变的是等价工具之间的对应关系，这种关系是通过扰动接口的构建已知的。 因此，我们比较策略在动作上的分布，而不是在词元上的分布。

paragraphs.en: The policy π θ \pi_{\theta} generates a response y y to a prompt x x , which contains the interface, the query, and any earlier turns. Within y y , the policy makes a decision each time it begins a tool call or begins the text that ends its turn, and each decision is an action a a , either a tool declared in x x or ∅ \varnothing , answering without a call. Writing y < t y_{<t} for the part of y y before its t t -th decision, we denote by π θ ​ ( a ∣ x , y < t ) \pi_{\theta}(a\mid x,y_{<t}) the probability that the policy continues y < t y_{<t} with action a a . We read this probability in one forward pass from the probability of the tokens that open a call and of each declared tool’s name after them, normalized over the declared tools (Appendix A ), as in work that reads the action probabilities of LLM agents from their token probabilities ( Carta et al., 2023 ; Tan et al., 2024 ) . The two interfaces name the same tool differently, so we index actions by equivalence rather than by name or position, and a tool and its counterpart under the other interface share an index. A tool that only one interface declares, such as a twin, has an index of its own, with probability zero under the interface that does not declare it, so probability moved onto such a tool counts as disagreement instead of being merged with another. Arguments do not enter this distribution and are trained by the task objective alone.
paragraphs.zh: 策略 π θ \pi_{\theta} 针对提示 x x 生成一个响应 y y，其中包含接口、查询以及任何先前的对话回合。 在 y y 中，每当策略开始调用工具或开始构成其回合结尾的文本时，都会做出一次决策；每次决策都是一个动作 a a，即 x x 中声明的工具或 ∅ \varnothing（表示无需调用直接作答）。 将 y y 中第 t t 个决策之前的部分记为 y < t y_{<t}，我们用 π θ ​ ( a ∣ x , y < t ) \pi_{\theta}(a\mid x,y_{<t}) 表示策略以动作 a a 延续 y < t y_{<t} 的概率。 我们通过一次前向传播计算该概率：从开启调用的词元概率以及其后每个已声明工具名称的概率出发，并在所有已声明工具上进行归一化（附录 A），这一方法类似于从 LLM 智能体的词元概率中读取动作概率的相关研究（Carta et al., 2023; Tan et al., 2024）。 两个接口对同一工具的命名不同，因此我们依据等价性而非名称或位置对动作进行索引；同一工具与其在另一接口下的对应版本共享一个索引。 仅由一个接口声明的工具（例如“twin”）拥有独立的索引，而在未声明该工具的接口下其概率为零；因此，分配给此类工具的概率被视为分歧，而非与其他工具合并。 参数不会进入此分布，且仅通过任务目标进行训练。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate CIPR in reinforcement-learning and supervised post-training of agents. If the consistency KL removes interface shortcuts rather than fitting the training perturbations, CIPR should raise accuracy under held-out perturbations, keep or raise accuracy on the original interface, and improve on multi-interface training, which sees the same perturbed interfaces without the consistency KL. We test these three predictions by adding CIPR to reinforcement learning for function calling (Section 4.2 ); we then apply it to supervised post-training on WebShop (Section 4.3 ) and ablate its components (Section 4.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在智能体的强化学习和监督式后训练中对 CIPR 进行了评估。 如果一致性 KL 移除了接口快捷方式，而不是拟合训练扰动，那么 CIPR 应该能在保留的扰动下提高准确率，在原始接口上保持或提升准确率，并在多接口训练中表现更好——这种训练在没有一致性 KL 的情况下会看到相同的扰动接口。 我们通过将 CIPR 添加到函数调用的强化学习（第 4.2 节）中，随后将其应用于 WebShop 的监督式后训练（第 4.3 节），并消融其各个组件（第 4.4 节），来验证这三种预测。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate on the 2,501 2{,}501 single-turn items of BFCL v4 ( Patil et al., 2025 ) that have a reference call, under thirteen perturbation types adapted from RobustBench-TC ( Zhou et al., 2026b ) (Appendix C ). None of them is used during training, and we report them in three groups. Typos & distractor tools introduces typos into the query or adds a distractor for every tool the task calls, either an unrelated tool renamed to resemble it or a duplicate with the same name whose description or parameters are corrupted. The six cost and latency types add a cheaper or faster equivalent of the correct tool under a new name, so that the familiar name now points to the worse choice. As in RobustBench-TC, the query in Cost & latency (explicit) asks for the better tool, for example “Please use a cost-effective option”. This request tells the agent what to prefer, so we add a harder version, Cost & latency (implicit) , in which the query only asks the agent to describe the available tools and states no preference. These two groups are the hardest test, because the right choice depends only on a stated cost or latency, and preferring a cheaper or faster tool is never rewarded during training. Beyond single-turn calls, we evaluate the three groups on the airline and retail domains of τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench ( Barres et al., 2026 ) , where the agent completes multi-turn tasks with a simulated user, and Appendix F also reports RoTBench ( Ye et al., 2024 ) , which corrupts tool and parameter names at graded levels.

paragraphs.en: We next apply CIPR to an agent trained by supervised learning, AgentLM-7B ( Zeng et al., 2024 ) , whose WebShop policy collapses when its actions are renamed ( Gu et al., 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: AgentLM is fine-tuned on agent trajectories mixed with general instruction data, and acts on WebShop ( Yao et al., 2022 ) through two actions named search and click . The released model already solves the task under its original action names, so we apply CIPR as self-distillation. The released model is the teacher and initializes the student, which we train to match it under canonical names and, through the rescoring consistency KL, under relabeled names, without additional rollouts.

paragraphs.en: Consistent with Gu et al. (2026) , renaming search and click to the synonyms find and press reduces the released model’s reward from 78.9 78.9 to 5.5 5.5 (Figure 3 ). After self-distillation, the agent reaches 81.0 81.0 under canonical names, the interface it is deployed with, against 75.7 75.7 for the released model behind the same adapter, so the adapter alone does not explain the gain. Seeing the names directly, the trained agent is also robust to neutral renaming, with 76.0 76.0 under the synonyms. Swapped names, each of which suggests the other action, drive both models to zero, which is why CIPR keeps the canonicalization adapter, behind which a misleading name never reaches the policy.
paragraphs.zh: 与 Gu et al. (2026) 的研究一致，将“搜索”和“点击”更名为其同义词“查找”和“按下”，会使已发布模型的奖励从 78.9 降至 5.5（图 3）。经过自蒸馏后，智能体在使用标准名称（即其部署时所采用的界面）时达到了 81.0，而使用相同适配器的已发布模型仅为 75.7，因此仅靠适配器本身无法解释这一性能提升。当直接看到这些名称时，训练后的智能体对中性更名也表现出较强的鲁棒性，在同义词命名下仍能达到 76.0。若将两个名称互换（每个名称都暗示了另一种操作），两种模型的奖励都会降至零，这正是 CIPR 保留标准化适配器的原因——在该适配器之后，误导性名称永远无法进入策略模型。

paragraphs.en: LLM agents learn to use tools through a particular interface, and the task objective cannot tell a decision that depends on the task from one that depends on how the tools are presented. We supply that distinction with CIPR, a self-supervised consistency KL between the agent’s action distributions under two interfaces whose equivalent actions are known by construction. Added to multi-interface training, it improves accuracy in all three groups of held-out BFCL perturbations on both backbones without lowering accuracy on the original interface (Table 1 ). Applied as self-distillation, it makes AgentLM robust to renaming its WebShop actions. Because the targets come from the policy itself, the objective needs no annotation beyond the task, which makes it a natural candidate for agentic training at scale.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 智能体通过特定接口学习使用工具，而任务目标无法区分一个依赖于任务的决策与一个依赖于工具呈现方式的决策。 我们通过 CIPR 提供了这种区分，这是一种自监督的一致性 KL 散度，用于衡量智能体在两种接口下的动作分布，而这两种接口中等效的动作是已知且由构造确定的。 除了多接口训练之外，该方法还能在所有三组保留的 BFCL 扰动上提升三种骨干网络的准确率，同时不会降低原始接口上的准确率（表 1）。 作为自蒸馏方法应用时，它能使 AgentLM 对 WebShop 动作名称的重命名具有鲁棒性。 由于目标来自策略本身，该目标无需任务之外的任何标注，因此成为大规模智能体训练的自然候选方案。

paragraphs.en: CIPR needs the canonicalization adapter at inference, because a name that misrepresents its action, such as the swapped WebShop names in Figure 3 , still misleads a trained agent that sees it directly. The consistency KL constrains which tool the agent calls and whether it calls one, while arguments are learned from the task loss alone, and argument errors barely change in our error analysis (Appendix E ). It also requires a perturbation whose equivalences are known, which is direct for tool lists but harder to construct for richer actions such as edits to a program. The rollout consistency KL samples an additional group of rollouts per prompt, which raises the cost of training. Our experiments use models of up to 9 9 B parameters, one training run per configuration, and mostly single-turn function calling, so the effect at larger scale and in long multi-turn tasks remains to be established.
paragraphs.zh: CIPR 在推理阶段需要规范化适配器，因为一个错误表示其行为的名称（例如图 3 中互换的 WebShop 名称）仍然会误导直接看到该名称的训练智能体。 一致性 KL 约束了智能体调用哪个工具以及是否调用一个工具，而参数仅通过任务损失学习，在我们的错误分析（附录 E）中，参数错误几乎没有变化。 它还需要一个已知等价关系的扰动，对于工具列表来说这很直接，但对于更复杂的操作（例如对程序的修改）则更难构建。 展开一致性 KL 为每个提示采样一组额外的展开结果，这会提高训练成本。 我们的实验使用了参数高达 990 亿的参数模型，每种配置仅进行一次训练运行，并且主要涉及单轮函数调用，因此在更大规模以及更长的多轮任务中的效果仍有待验证。

paragraphs.en: Table 5 lists the thirteen held-out perturbation types, adapted from RobustBench-TC ( Zhou et al., 2026b ) , and the group of Table 1 in which we report each. The six cost and latency types share one construction. The tool list contains the correct tool and an equivalent with the same description but a higher stated cost or latency; the equivalent keeps the original tool’s name and the correct tool receives a new one, so that the familiar name points to the costlier or slower tool. The cost or latency is stated as a tag, in natural language, or as a tag together with an abbreviated name for the correct tool. Each type is evaluated in two versions. In the explicit version, as in RobustBench-TC, the query asks for the cheaper or faster tool; in the implicit version, which we add, the query asks the agent to describe the available tools and their properties before acting and states no preference. With canonical names, we canonicalize after constructing each interface, and because canonical identifiers follow the tool order, we average two orders, the original one and one in which the costlier or slower equivalent comes first; with original names, we use the original order. Figure 4 shows one item under each construction.

paragraphs.en: A response is correct if it calls the correct tool with the correct arguments. The released checker validates a single-tool item against the first declared tool and a duplicated name against its first declaration, so once a perturbation adds a tool it can reject the correct call and accept a call to the added one; we validate against the tool that the reference call names and accept a call if any declaration of the called name permits it. paragraphs.en: We also evaluate the same models on RoTBench ( Ye et al., 2024 ) , which scores tool calls under five levels of noise in the names of tools and parameters.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还使用 RoTBench（Ye et al., 2024）对同一批模型进行了评估，该基准通过工具名称和参数中的五个不同噪声级别来评分工具调用。

paragraphs.en: We use the First-Turn split and all five shipped levels, a clean tool list and the slight , medium , heavy , and union corruptions derived from it. Following the definitions of Ye et al. (2024) , the slight level inserts, omits, or substitutes characters in the names of half of the tools or half of the parameters, and the medium level reverses such names or replaces them with random strings. The heavy level either shuffles all tool names among the tools, which detaches each name from its description, or, in half of the tools, adds a mandatory parameter with a random name and shuffles the parameter names, each with probability one half. The union level combines one noise on tool names with one on parameter names, drawn from the other levels. The corruptions ship as data, so every model sees an identical tool list at a given level. Scoring is the benchmark’s deterministic Content-Filling criterion, which requires the predicted call to match an accepted reference on tool name, argument keys, and argument values. We apply the benchmark’s matcher unmodified and recompute it per item so that original and canonical names can be compared item by item.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用“第一回合”划分方式以及所有五个已发布的关卡，一个干净的工具列表，以及由此衍生出的轻微、中等、严重和联合四种数据扰动。根据 Ye et al. (2024) 的定义，轻微扰动会在半数工具或半数参数的名称中插入、删除或替换字符；中等扰动则会反转这些名称，或用随机字符串替代它们。严重扰动则有两种可能：以一半的概率将所有工具名称在工具之间打乱，从而将每个名称与其描述分离；或以一半的概率在半数工具中添加一个带有随机名称的强制参数，并打乱参数名称。联合扰动则从其他扰动类型中各选取一种工具名称扰动和参数名称扰动进行组合。这些扰动数据会作为原始数据一同提供，因此每个模型在特定关卡下都会看到完全相同的工具列表。评分采用该基准测试中确定性的“内容填充”标准，要求预测的调用在工具名称、参数键和参数值上与参考答案完全匹配。我们直接使用基准测试中的匹配器，并对每个条目重新计算匹配结果，以便将原始名称与标准名称逐条进行比较。

paragraphs.en: For canonical names, we replace every tool name with a canonical identifier assigned by position and leave descriptions, argument values, and the query unchanged. Because RoTBench’s corruptions act mainly on names, canonicalizing a shipped corruption file would give a corrupted name the same canonical identifier as its clean version and undo most of the corruption. We therefore canonicalize the clean record first and re-apply each level’s corruption to the canonical identifier. This preserves the structure of each level, introduces no duplicated identifier with either original or canonical names, and keeps the queries and their order identical, so the pairing is exact.
paragraphs.zh: 对于规范名称，我们将每个工具名称替换为按位置分配的规范标识符，同时保留描述、参数值和问题不变。 由于 RoTBench 的破坏操作主要作用于名称，因此对已生成的破坏文件进行规范化处理，会使被破坏的名称获得与其干净版本相同的规范标识符，从而撤销大部分破坏操作。 因此，我们首先对干净记录进行规范化处理，然后将每一级的破坏操作重新应用于该规范标识符。 这样既保留了每一级的结构，也不会与原始名称或规范名称产生重复的标识符，同时还能保持问题和其顺序完全一致，从而实现精确匹配。

paragraphs.en: Table 10 reports accuracy with original and with canonical names. Under original names, every model loses the most accuracy on the heavy and union levels. Canonicalization costs accuracy on the clean and lightly corrupted tool lists and recovers it on the heavy and union levels. On the heavy level, half of the items shuffle the tool names, so under original names each name labels the description of a different tool, which can mislead a model that selects tools by name; under canonical names the shuffled labels carry no meaning, and the choice falls back on the descriptions. Under canonical names, the spread between the clean tool list and the corrupted levels narrows for every model, in several cases by more than half.
paragraphs.zh: 表 10 报告了使用原始名称和标准名称时的准确率。 在使用原始名称时，所有模型在“重度”和“联合”级别上的准确率下降最为显著。 标准化操作会牺牲“干净”和“轻度损坏”工具列表的准确率，但在“重度”和“联合”级别上又能恢复这种准确率。 在“重度”级别中，一半的项目会打乱工具名称，因此在使用原始名称时，每个名称都会标注一个不同工具的说明，这可能会误导通过名称选择工具的智能体；而使用标准名称时，这些被打乱的标签不再具有实际意义，选择将重新依赖工具说明。 在使用标准名称时，对于所有模型，“干净”工具列表与损坏级别之间的准确率差异都会缩小，在某些情况下甚至缩小了超过一半。

paragraphs.en: The two backbones are evaluated with the tool-call format each was trained for, so entries can be compared within a backbone but not across backbones. On Qwen2.5-3B, canonical names help on the corrupted levels, and with them CIPR and multi-interface training share the best pooled accuracy. The largest effect in the table is scale, since the largest CIPR model is both the most accurate and the flattest across corruption levels, with a drop of only 0.3 0.3 points from the clean tool list once names are canonical.
